about: What origin/main typed, and the consequence route it chose, for every sentence in benchmarks/default_path_sentences.json (default:<id>) and benchmarks/recognizer_transcripts.json (replay:<id>), each dictated once in this order into a fresh field on the fake Mac of tests/fake_platform.py with its protocol 1 helper. tests/test_whole_program.py requires the same with a protocol 1 and a protocol 2 helper while the helper word-evidence switches are off. Record a new case here when one is added to either corpus; change an existing one only for a deliberate change in what is typed or routed.
